== Template:Item/Header ==

Displays the header section of an item tooltip, including:
* Item icon with quality tier sparkle effect
* Item name with tier-based coloring
* Item type/slot
* Relic flag (if applicable)
* Item value or "Unsellable"

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Default !! Description
|-
| '''icon''' || Yes || || The item icon image (use {{tl|SparkleIcon}} for quality tiers)
|-
| '''name''' || Yes || || The display name of the item
|-
| '''tier''' || No || 0 || Quality tier: 0 = Normal (white), 1 = Blessed (cyan), 2 = Godly (purple)
|-
| '''type''' || No || || Item type or slot (e.g., "Primary - 2-Handed", "Chest")
|-
| '''relic''' || No || || Set to any value to display "Relic Item" tag
|-
| '''value''' || No || || Item value in gold, or "Unsellable"
|}

=== Example ===

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Header
|icon=[[File:Copper Sword.png|80px]]
|name=Blessed Copper Sword
|tier=1
|type=Primary - 1-Handed
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/Header
|icon=[[File:Copper Sword.png|80px]]
|name=Blessed Copper Sword
|tier=1
|type=Primary - 1-Handed
}}

----
